description: check_extensions returns Error::UnexpectedExtension for any extension not in the whitelist, regardless of criticality. Error::UnhandledCriticalExtension (declared in the enum, listed in verify_simple docs as a return value) is never actually returned. Callers matching on pkix_chain_simple::Error::UnhandledCriticalExtension will never trigger, silently missing critical-extension rejections in their error handling.
title: pkix-chain-simple: UnhandledCriticalExtension variant unreachable
